articles.title: How commercial & industrial businesses can build a smarter energy strategy with solar and BESS
articles.summary: Most Indian businesses do not have a single energy strategy. Instead, they have a series of energy decisions made years apart—a rooftop solar plant approved in 2021, an open-access contract signed in 2023, a diesel generator replaced in 2019, or a tariff category that has not been reviewed since the connection was sanctioned. Each decision may have made sense individually, but together they can leave significant value on the table.

articles.summary: Karnataka Deputy Chief Minister G Parameshwara announced immediate relief for drought-hit farmers, offering Rs 2,500 each. articles.title: India's forex reserves fall $14.88 billion to $765.90 billion in week ended September 18
articles.summary: India's foreign exchange reserves decreased by $14.88 billion, bringing the total to $765.90 billion. The decline occurred during the week ending September 18, according to the Reserve Bank of India data. Foreign currency assets fell by $14.82 billion, while gold reserves rose slightly by $68 million. Despite the recent decrease, reserves had increased significantly from the previous year. Overall, India’s foreign exchange reserves have shown considerable growth in recent months.
